channel.title: Codehimblog – New software listings
channel.description: Codehimblog is an independent directory of free and open-source Windows software. Compare features, check Windows compatibility and find official download sources.

item.title: Adobe Acrobat Pro 2026 X64 Suite – Productivity & Office
item.description: A free, portable PDF editor for Windows that includes OCR, preflight tools and removes evaluation watermarks.

item.title: AEM Compose – Developer Tools
item.description: A command‑line tool that helps you work with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) instances, handling packages, configurations and repository nodes.

item.title: Autocad 2026 Hangul Portable Dwg Ko – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: A portable version of AutoCAD 2026 with Korean interface that runs without installation and uses offline licensing.

item.title: Azr – System Utilities
item.description: Azr adds a glass‑style Dock, Dynamic Island, menu bar, quick controls and desktop widgets to customize the Windows desktop.

item.title: Battery Hub – System Utilities
item.description: Live battery monitor for wireless mice, keyboards, headsets and controllers on Windows.

item.title: Beekeeper Studio – Developer Tools
item.description: A modern, easy‑to‑use graphical SQL editor and database manager for multiple database systems.

item.title: Capcut Pro PC Hangul Watermark Ko – Audio & Video
item.description: A portable video editing program for Windows that removes watermarks, adds Korean subtitles and unlocks professional features without needing an internet connection.

item.title: Cc Studio Pro PC Hangul Watermark Ko – System Utilities
item.description: A portable Windows tool that removes watermarks from CapCut Pro PC and provides offline licensing without needing an internet connection.

item.title: Chameleon Ultra GUI – System Utilities
item.description: A graphical interface for the Chameleon Ultra and Chameleon Lite RFID development devices, allowing users to read, write and manage RFID tags from Windows.

item.title: ClipLine – Productivity & Office
item.description: A clipboard, file snapshot, and sticky‑note utility that shows copied items on a hanging line at the top of the screen.

item.title: Condr – Developer Tools
item.description: Condr lets you run many terminal agents together, keep them running when you close the window or lose connection, and manage local and remote agents from a single desktop client.

item.title: Cuktech Ultra Tray – System Utilities
item.description: A small tray program that connects via Bluetooth to a Cuktech Ultra charger and shows the total power of its four ports directly on the taskbar, with detailed voltage, current and power readings and the ability to turn ports on or off.

item.title: dmm-tools – System Utilities
item.description: Open-source desktop and command‑line app for reading, logging and graphing digital multimeters and clamp meters over USB or Bluetooth.

item.title: DS5 Untethered – System Utilities
item.description: Enables DualSense (PS5) haptic feedback and adaptive triggers over Bluetooth on Windows by creating a virtual wired controller.

item.title: Hangar Türkçe Yama İstemcisi İndir PC 2026 – Games
item.description: A portable Windows program that lets you download and apply Turkish language patches for games from Hangar.

item.title: HangarAI – Developer Tools
item.description: HangarAI lets you run multiple AI coding agents in a single native Windows window, manage their tasks on a shared board, and interact with them from your phone.

item.title: HMS-CPAP – Productivity & Office
item.description: A lightweight local‑only viewer that reads CPAP machine data from SD cards, Bluetooth, Wi‑Fi or files and shows nightly sleep statistics in a web dashboard.

item.title: Lightroom MCP – Productivity & Office
item.description: A server that lets AI assistants interact with Adobe Lightroom Classic to search, rate, edit, and manage photos through chat commands.

item.title: Linger – Internet & Browsers
item.description: Linger is a self‑hosted chat and voice application for small groups of friends, providing text rooms, voice rooms, direct messages, file sharing and a buddy list.

item.title: Natron – Audio & Video
item.description: Natron is a free, open‑source video compositing program that lets you create visual effects and motion graphics using a node‑based workflow.

item.title: Photoshop 2026 Portable Hangul AI Ko – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: A portable, free version of Photoshop 2026 with Korean language support, AI features and no installation required.

item.title: PicArd – Developer Tools
item.description: PicArd is a low‑cost USB programmer for PIC microcontrollers that works with an Arduino Uno and runs on Windows.

item.title: Qdomyos Zwift – System Utilities
item.description: A bridge that lets smart treadmills, bikes, ellipticals and rowers work with Zwift and other virtual cycling apps on Windows.

item.title: Quadband Card Studio – Productivity & Office
item.description: A companion program for Midwest Gadgets Quadband cards that lets you read, write and manage magnetic‑stripe, HF/NFC, UHF and LF cards using supported readers.

item.title: QuickDictate – Productivity & Office
item.description: QuickDictate lets you press a hotkey, speak, and have your words typed into any window on Windows, using your own cloud API key or optional offline models.

item.title: Shumai – Productivity & Office
item.description: Shumai is an open‑source platform for creative teams to store, review and share media files, offering Frame.io‑like collaboration features with optional AI assistance.

item.title: South Network Protocol Analysis Tool – Networking Tools
item.description: A Windows desktop tool that parses, validates, frames, and transmits power communication messages for many protocols without needing Python installed.

item.title: Ultrakill Cheat Trainer – Games
item.description: A portable trainer that adds cheat features and an overlay to the Ultrakill game on Windows.

item.title: Windows Clipboard History Manager – Productivity & Office
item.description: Free open-source Windows clipboard manager with searchable history, image previews, tags, editing and backup.

item.title: YukiOS – System Utilities
item.description: A web‑based desktop environment that runs in a single browser tab, offering multiple switchable desktop modes such as macOS, Windows‑like, ChromeOS, and a game‑console layout.

item.title: CleanWin – System Utilities
item.description: A lightweight Windows utility that lets you control privacy settings, remove unwanted built‑in apps, clean temporary files and access small system tools from the tray.

item.title: PC Toolkit Pro – System Utilities
item.description: A free Windows system optimizer and cleaner that offers one‑click scans, junk file removal, memory optimization, startup management and system monitoring.

item.title: Rust Hover Preview – System Utilities
item.description: A free, open-source Windows system tray utility that shows instant previews of files when you hover over them in File Explorer and other file dialogs.

item.title: AttachéCase4 – Security & Privacy
item.description: File encryption software for Windows

item.title: ba-click-fx-desktop – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: Adds animated click effects and cursor trails to the Windows desktop, using visuals inspired by the game Blue Archive.

item.title: ElixirOffice – Productivity & Office
item.description: An open‑source office suite that mimics Microsoft Office’s ribbon, shortcuts and layout, letting users create and edit Word, Excel and PowerPoint files offline.

item.title: FreeDevTools – Developer Tools
item.description: A free collection of over 125,000 developer resources with a command‑line installer that lets you download tools, icons, cheat sheets and more without needing an account.

item.title: FreeShape – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: FreeShape is a free offline parametric CAD program that works like Onshape, letting you create parts, assemblies, drawings and sheet‑metal designs on your computer.

item.title: Kantor – Productivity & Office
item.description: A small, fast office suite with Sheets, Docs, and Slides that can open and save Excel, Word, and PowerPoint files on Windows.

item.title: KanzonasPDF – Productivity & Office
item.description: A free, open‑source PDF viewer and editor for Windows that lets you read, comment, edit text and images, fill and sign forms, protect, redact and export PDFs without watermarks or accounts.

item.title: lark-cli – Productivity & Office
item.description: Command‑line interface for Lark/Feishu that lets you manage messages, documents, calendars, files and other business features from a terminal.

item.title: LogiSheets – Productivity & Office
item.description: LogiSheets is an AI‑friendly spreadsheet program that works with real Excel (.xlsx) files and lets both people and AI agents edit data together.

item.title: Macro – Productivity & Office
item.description: Macro is an all‑in‑one workspace that combines email, chat, documents, tasks, calls, CRM and more into a single searchable interface for teams.

item.title: MR Office – Productivity & Office
item.description: An open‑source office suite that lets you create and edit Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF and code files with built‑in AI assistance, available as a free desktop app for Windows.

item.title: OpenWorkBuddy – Productivity & Office
item.description: OpenWorkBuddy is a local‑first AI office workbench that turns prompts and source material into editable PPTX, DOCX, XLSX and HTML files using the model of your choice.

item.title: Schreibzeug – Productivity & Office
item.description: Self‑hosted office suite that lets you edit Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF files locally, with real‑time collaboration and no external document server.

item.title: YuE2 Studio – Audio & Video
item.description: A native Windows app that generates full songs with vocals, sheet music and covers using local AI models, without needing Python.

item.title: Amp Up – System Utilities
item.description: Replacement software for the Turn Up USB volume mixer that adds per‑app audio control, lighting and macro support.

item.title: AutoOS – System Utilities
item.description: AutoOS automates moving to a new Windows installation on a separate partition and applies a set of performance and privacy tweaks for gaming and productivity.

item.title: BananaSplit – Audio & Video
item.description: A low‑latency virtual audio mixer for Windows that provides multiple input strips, buses, built‑in EQ, compression, recording and network audio features.
